newsitem.title: UK: Newcastle United set for stockmarket float - papers.
newsitem.headline: Newcastle United set for stockmarket float - papers.

text.p: Newcastle United, currently fourth in Britain's football premier league and playing in the Uefa Cup this season, will announce plans for a stockmarket flotation on Thursday, British newspapers reported.

The papers said that the holding company of the football club could be valued at around 150 million stg and the club will use the moneys raised from a share issue to enlarge its ground to a 50,000 all-seat stadium with plans for 70,000 later.
In October, the club appointed Mark Corbridge of investment bank NatWest Markets to advise on a flotation.
